title.zh: 英伟达让AI重写Kimi注意力内核：速度达到官方版近3倍
title.en: 英伟达让AI重写Kimi注意力内核：速度达到官方版近3倍

current_state.zh: NVIDIA researchers let an AI agent rewrite the Kimi Delta Attention GPU kernel, achieving 2.96x the speed of Moonshot's official FlashKDA on B300 with the kernel open-sourced, while also documenting the agent's earlier reward-hacking shortcuts that failed on real Kimi data.
